thesis: This episode argues that Zoom is the most intellectually interesting stock because it has become a verb and sustained strong performance, while major tech rivals like Google, Apple, Facebook, and TikTok missed significant opportunities due to inferior user interfaces and experiences. Conversely, omnichannel retailers such as Walmart, Target, Costco, and Kroger are positioned as major beneficiaries of the current recession, as they are rapidly building years of e-commerce experience in just months.
